subject: Engage Accelerator pact + POC timetable & owners
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Lina Torres <lina.torres@olivetech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-07T15:12:00-04:00
Subject: Engage Accelerator pact + POC timetable & owners

Hi Lina —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick post-call recap and a suggested lightweight POC plan so we can align on success criteria, timing, and owners.

Key discovery notes
- Primary use case: intent-based routing for support triage (low-latency responses for new tickets, reranking of suggested KB articles).
- Data: ~1.2M tickets/year, daily ingest spikes around M-F 9am-3pm.
- Security posture: SOC 2 controls required, SAML SSO mandatory, no PHI.

Proposed POC (8 weeks, goal: production-readiness signal)
1) Week 0 (Kickoff): access & connectivity, data sample delivery, SSO test. Owner: Marissa.
2) Week 1-2 (Baseline & ingestion): Redwood runs a 10k-ticket ingest, confirm format and latency profile. Owner: Naomi/Marissa.
3) Week 3-4 (Model tuning & eval): run reranker/response generation model; collect quality metrics vs baseline. Success criteria: >12% reduction in triage time and >8% precision uplift on suggested KB matches. Owner: Rishi.
4) Week 5-6 (Load & latency validation): steady-state throughput at 200 reqs/s with p95 latency < 250ms. Owner: Marissa.
5) Week 7-8 (Sign-off & handoff): rollout plan and runbook for staging. Owner: Naomi.

Immediate asks (owners & dates)
- OliveTech: share a representative 10k-ticket sample (anonymized) by 2026-09-14 — Lina
- Redwood: share POC checklist and onboarding playbook by EOD 2026-09-08 — Naomi (attached)
- Legal: initial SOW + redlines target in 2 weeks — Naomi/Rishi

Attachments: POC-Checklist.xlsx (checklist & milestone templates), MAP_draft.docx (mutual action plan draft).

If this looks good, I’ll schedule the kickoff for the week of 2026-09-14 and loop in our infra engineer for the SSO test.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0126

[Attachment: POC-Checklist.xlsx] [Attachment: MAP_draft.docx]

From: Lina Torres <lina.torres@olivetech.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-08T09:03:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Engage Accelerator pact + POC timetable & owners

Thanks Naomi — sounds promising. A few quick clarifications before we lock dates: 

- Data sample: can you confirm accepted formats (CSV + JSON lines)? We need to ensure PHI is scrubbed — I’m attaching our security questionnaire.
- SSO: we run Okta; will SAML metadata exchange be sufficient or do you need additional firewall exceptions?
- Legal: our procurement lead will want an initial redline of the SOW before kickoff; is a 2-week turnaround comfortable?

If those are OK, we can aim for 2026-09-14 kickoff.

Best,
Lina Torres
Director, AI & Automation | OliveTech
lina.torres@olivetech.com

[Attachment: OliveTech_Security_Questionnaire.docx]

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Lina Torres <lina.torres@olivetech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-08T11:27:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Engage Accelerator pact + POC timetable & owners

Lina — great questions, answered inline below.

- Data formats: CSV and JSONL both fine. We’ll provide a small ingestion template (see POC-Checklist.xlsx). For the sample, please remove direct identifiers; tokenization/anonymization guidelines are in the checklist.
- SSO / Okta: SAML metadata exchange is sufficient in most cases. The SSO test can be done during Week 0; firewall exceptions are not typically necessary unless you have egress restrictions — Marissa will surface any networking notes.
- Legal / SOW redlines: 2 weeks is reasonable. We will send a draft SOW and an editable DocuSign envelope link so your counsel can annotate directly: https://www.docusign.com/DocuSign/Envelope/LAH3K2-OLV-1789

Operational notes & risks
- Traffic spikes: to minimize cold-start latency at peak, we recommend enabling a small warm pool during the trial (discuss cost impact in pricing).
- Data retention: default retention for trials is 30 days; if you need different retention for audit purposes let us know.

Next steps
- I’ll share the onboarding calendar invite for 2026-09-14 and upload the sample ingestion template to the shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDefG-engage-accelerator
- Rishi will follow up with a provisional pricing outline and optional dedicated capacity uplift.

Thanks,
Naomi

[Inline: POC-Checklist guidance]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Lina Torres <lina.torres@olivetech.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-09T14:00:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Engage Accelerator pact + POC timetable & owners

Hi Lina / team — quick pricing & options so you can share with procurement. This is provisional and will be finalized in the SOW: 

- Hosted POC (metered): estimated $6,500 - $8,000 total for 8-week engagement (ingest, tuning, evaluation).
- Option A — Dedicated pilot (reserved capacity): $12,000/month committed for the trial if you want guaranteed throughput and lower per-token during peak.
- Optional add-ons: extended log retention (+$800/month), dedicated support SLA (+$1,500/month).

If you prefer, we can include a commitment clause in the SOW that converts usage into a pilot credit when you sign a 12-month Dedicated contract.

Marissa — can you confirm resource availability for Week 0 networking/SSO steps?

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-09T14:38:00-04:00
Subject: Internal: scheduling & infra prep (OliveTech kickoff)

Naomi — quick internal note before I join the kickoff: I’ll reserve 2 hours on 2026-09-14 for SSO + sample ingest. I need the sample schema by EOD 09/08 to validate transformations. I’ll also request temporary test credentials from infra.

Checklist I’ll run through
- Confirm JSONL/CSV sample matches schema (fields, timestamp format)
- Validate SAML metadata exchange with Okta test tenant
- Run a 5k-ticket ingest to validate latency and error handling

I’ll flag anything blocking within 24 hours of the sample receipt.

— Marissa
